IPAD_TOUCH_ENHANCER.ModuleDescription: Optimizes Foundry VTT v13 for iPadOS/iOS Safari: Adds a draggable double-click/right-click mini-bar, fixes for window clipping and duplicate checkboxes, and more.

EnableModule.Name: Enable module
EnableModule.Hint: Master switch to enable or disable all features and visual fixes of this module for your client.

EnableTouchBar.Name: Double-click / Right-click mini-bar
EnableTouchBar.Hint: Adds a draggable mini-bar to emulate double-click and right-click actions, with a toggle button in the Scene Controls bar to control its visibility.

EnableSingleTapHud.Name: Token HUD on Short Tap
EnableSingleTapHud.Hint: Opens the Token HUD on a short tap of a token.

EnableHudSheetButton.Name: Actor Sheet Button
EnableHudSheetButton.Hint: Adds a button to the Token HUD that opens the selected token’s Actor Sheet.

HideHudElevationArrow.Name: Hide Caret (^)
HideHudElevationArrow.Hint: Removes the system datalist dropdown indicator (^) rendered by iPadOS Safari over the token elevation field.

FixSettingsOverflow.Name: Fix Text Overflow
FixSettingsOverflow.Hint: Wrap long text and prevent clipping in Game Settings.

FixWindows.Name: Fix Application Windows
FixWindows.Hint: Adjusts application window positioning to prevent clipping at the bottom of the screen.

FixCheckboxes.Name: Fix Duplicate Checkboxes
FixCheckboxes.Hint: Prevents checkboxes from appearing twice in the interface.

FixRegionLegend.Name: Fix Region Legend List
FixRegionLegend.Hint: Ensures the regions list is visible.

CompactNotifications.Name: Compact Notifications
CompactNotifications.Hint: Makes notifications smaller and moves them higher up.

DisableAllNotifications.Name: Disable All Notifications
DisableAllNotifications.Hint: Hide all notifications in the interface.

NotificationTop.Name: Notification Top Margin (px)
NotificationTop.Hint: Distance between the notification container and the top edge of the screen in pixels.

NotificationLeft.Name: Notification Left Margin (px)
NotificationLeft.Hint: Distance between the notification container and the left edge of the screen in pixels.

NotificationWidth.Name: Notification Width (px)
NotificationWidth.Hint: Maximum width of notifications in pixels.

NotificationFontSize.Name: Notification Font Size (px)
NotificationFontSize.Hint: Text size of notifications in pixels.

EnableReloadButton.Name: Reload Button
EnableReloadButton.Hint: Adds a page reload button to the sidebar settings category.
